source: EA Engineering, Appendix A. Engineering Drawings, Final Residential Design, September 2025 (100% Plans for Construction), project 1578546. C-110 is taken from the 90% Pre-Final Design set (May 2025) and is flagged accordingly - it is absent from the Final set, whose sheet numbering skips from C-109 to C-111.
crs: EPSG:6418 (CA State Plane II, US survey feet)
registration: Per-sheet affine, uniform scale taken exactly from the sheet's own /VP rectilinear measure (an AutoCAD /RL scale, NOT GeoPDF georeferencing). Eight sheets (C-104/105/106/108/109/111/112/201) were placed in v6 by ortho NCC refined on the printed survey nodes. C-103, C-107 and C-110 were placed here by two independent methods that had to agree: (A) a rotation sweep with translation voting against the sheet's printed State Plane node table, with scale locked so k nodes give 2k equations against 3 unknowns; and (B) correlation of the rendered sheet against the app's own orthophoto, which knows nothing of the node table. Accepted only where the two landed in the same place. C-101, C-102 and C-202 remain unregistered.
